consent.title: Turn on the camera and microphone for this recording
consent.explanation: This app needs both only while you record. Press the button below and choose Allow when asked.

denied.title: The camera or microphone is blocked
denied.explanation: Your Mac is keeping this app from using the camera or microphone.
denied.recovery_path: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera → turn on this app; then open Microphone → turn on this app, then press the button again

in_browser.explanation: Your browser is blocking the camera or microphone for this site.
in_browser.recovery_path: Click the icon left of the address, set Camera and Microphone to Allow, then press the button again

unavailable.title: Camera recording is unavailable here
unavailable.explanation: This app window does not provide camera capture. You can still use Pick a video file.

consent.title: Turn on the microphone for this recording
consent.explanation: Trillion needs the microphone while you record your voice. Press the button below and choose Allow when asked.

denied.title: The microphone is blocked
denied.explanation: Your Mac is keeping this app from using the microphone.
denied.recovery_path: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone → turn on this app, then press the button again

in_browser.explanation: Your browser is blocking the microphone for this site.
in_browser.recovery_path: Click the icon left of the address, set Microphone to Allow, then press the button again

unavailable.title: Voice recording is unavailable here
unavailable.explanation: This app window does not provide microphone capture.

payload.label: Record video
payload.description: Captures browser or adapter-provided media, stages bytes through reusable material evidence, stores local playback refs separately, and publishes descriptor-driven media records through workflow.

payload.name: record-video-save-recording-state
payload.description: Save one descriptor-scoped capture lifecycle event.

payload.name: record-video-save-captured-media
payload.description: Save one descriptor-scoped media record with reusable material evidence and local playback refs.

payload.name: record-video-save-recording-error
payload.description: Save one descriptor-scoped capture error event.

payload.name: record-video-set-recording-name
payload.description: Replace the display-name field record without touching media metadata or other fields.

payload.name: record-video-remove-recording
payload.description: Atomically retract every segment of one media record from the maintained projection.

payload.name: record-video-set-recording-notes
payload.description: Replace the notes field record without touching media metadata or other fields.

payload.name: record-video-set-recording-subtitle
payload.description: Replace the subtitle field record without touching media metadata or other fields.

payload.name: stage-recording-session-from-presentation-plan
payload.description: Convert one video presentation plan into recording-session DATA; readiness and authorization remain separate from compilation.
